detailed_description: vCard to CSV Converter turns pasted BEGIN:VCARD blocks into spreadsheet-ready CSV rows. Paste one or more VCF contacts, choose comma, semicolon, or tab output, and review columns for first_name,last_name,full_name,email,phone,company,title,address before importing the result into a spreadsheet, CRM, or cleanup workflow.
usage_steps: Paste one or more BEGIN:VCARD blocks from a .vcf export.
Choose comma, semicolon, or tab as the CSV delimiter.
Review the contact count and the generated columns for names, email, phone, company, title, and address.
Copy the CSV text and test it with your spreadsheet or CRM importer before a bulk import.
usage_examples: Turn a phone or address book VCF export into rows you can inspect in a spreadsheet.
Check whether email, phone, company, title, and address fields survive before a CRM import.
Convert a small batch of contacts when you need a quick CSV handoff without setting up a desktop converter.

faqs.question: Is vCard to CSV Converter free?
faqs.answer: Yes. vCard to CSV Converter runs free in your browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: What fields does it export?
faqs.answer: The CSV includes first_name,last_name,full_name,email,phone,company,title,address columns parsed from common vCard fields.

faqs.question: Does it import contacts into a CRM automatically?
faqs.answer: No. It creates CSV text only. Copy the output, then use your spreadsheet or CRM import flow.

faqs.question: Does it support every vCard property?
faqs.answer: It focuses on common contact fields. Review the CSV if your VCF includes custom properties, multiple phone numbers, or unusual address formatting.
